MESSAGES FROM THE LOK SABHA 
SECRETARY-GENERAL: Madam, I have to report to the House the 
following messages received from the Lok Sabha, signed by the Secretary-
General of the Lok Sabha: 
(I) 
I am directed to inform you that Lok Sabha, at its sitting held on 
Tuesday, the, 26 th February, 2002, adopted the following motion 
regarding filling up of the casual vacancies in the Joint Committee on 
Stock Market Scam and Matters relating thereto:- 
"That this House do appoint Shri C.P. Radhakrishnan and Shri 
Srichand Kriplani to the Joint Committee on Stock Market Scam and 
Matters Relating thereto in the vacancies caused by the resignation 
of Shri Vijay Goel and Shri Harin Pathak." 
(II) 
I am directed to inform you that Lok Sabha, at its sitting held on 
Tuesday, the 26th February, 2002, adopted the following motion:- 
"That this House do recommend to Rajya Sabha that Rajya Sabha 
do  agree  to  nominate  seven   Members  from   Rajya  Sabha  to

RE. KILLING OF TRAIN PASSENGERS AT GODHRA IN GUJARAT 
THE LEADER OF THE OPPOSITION (DR. MANMOHAN SINGH): 
Madam, through you, I wish to draw the attention of the Government to the 
ghastly tragedy that took place in Gujarat which has led to a loss of many 
innocent lives. At this stage, it is not my intention to go into the issue of why it 
has happened, or, who is responsible for it. But, it is the solemn obligation of 
both the State Government as well as th e Central Government to protect the 
lives of honest citizens of this country. We, therefore, urge upon the Government 
to make a suo motu statement on the subject, prefer ably today, if not today, 
latest by tomorrow.
